subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue remain a separate acceptance tracker for restart-free WhatsApp phone-code 515 finalization, or should that proof requirement be folded into the canonical phone-code login PR/issue before merge?
rationale: Current main already has QR 515 recovery, but the reported phone-code path is unmerged and the active PRs change public CLI/plugin API plus persisted auth-state behavior.

options.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
options.body: Use this issue to require live proof that phone-code pairing no longer needs a gateway restart after 515 recovery, even if the broader phone-code fallback lands elsewhere.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code PR
options.body: Make the active phone-code PR's acceptance criteria explicitly cover this recovery sequence and close this only after that PR merges.

options.title: Pause Until API Direction Settles
options.body: Leave this issue open but make no implementation commitment until maintainers decide the generic channel-auth seam for phone-code login.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to require live proof that phone-code pairing no longer needs a gateway restart after 515 recovery, even if the broader phone-code fallback lands elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses public CLI, plugin auth API, docs, and WhatsApp session-state boundaries where the history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
